title: The Recent letter from the office
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：recent　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 recent 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the trader wrote of ① a recent letter from the office in the list, and everybody in the market said at once that it was ② so recent that nobody in the market would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the trader, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the recent ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the recent letter from the office that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list for October 1971 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too recent to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the partner who had come to help; the recent ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far stall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a recent change in the rules, and said that no partner in his right mind would call it ⑥ as recent as the change in the rules they had once had in the old market. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was recent or not, and he said so.

By 1984 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was ⑦ something recent, and nothing besides. The partner from the next market called the whole plan ⑧ quite recent; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the list kept the names of the recent ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1987, year after year, she wrote of another recent letter from the office in the same list, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less recent than anybody had expected. ⑩ The recent change in the rules that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1989, was the one she could never quite name; the recent ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 最近（前置定语 a recent letter from the office：1977 年货商在货单里记下的那件最近的来函）
B. adj. 最近／新近（两处加强说法：so recent that … 与 no less recent than …）
C. adj. 最近／新近（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 最近（表语 too recent to do：母亲觉得它太最近，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 新近（前置定语 a recent change in the rules：叔叔把整件事称作一桩新近的改动）
F. adj. 新近（同级比较 as recent as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩规矩上的新近改动相比）
G. adj. 新近（后置定语 something recent：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 新近（受程度副词修饰 quite recent：那位伙计的评价）

items.q: a recent letter from the office
the recent letter from the office that
a recent change in the rules
The recent change in the rules that

answers.why: recent 意为“最近”，1977 年货商在货单里记下的是“一件最近的来函”，此处作前置定语 a recent letter from the office。
recent 意为“最近”，此处用 so recent that 结构，说它最近到集市里没人敢靠近。
recent 意为“最近”，货单上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的最近办公室最近的来函，等于最高级的说法。
recent 意为“最近”，母亲认为这件东西“太最近了，谁也用不上”，too recent to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
recent 意为“新近”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩新近的改动”，此处作前置定语 a recent change in the rules。
recent 意为“新近”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩规矩上的新近改动一样新近”，同级比较用 as recent as。
recent 意为“新近”，货单上那半行字要的是“新近的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something recent。
recent 意为“新近”，邻集市来的那位伙计认为这套计划“相当新近”，quite 修饰原级 recent。
recent 意为“新近”，no less recent than 表示“其新近不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之新近不亚于任何人的预料。
recent 意为“新近”，母亲 1989 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的新近改动”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1977 年，货商在货单里记下了一件最近的来函。（a recent letter from the office）
它最近到集市里没有一个人敢靠近。（so recent that …）
母亲觉得它太最近，谁也用不上。（too recent to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩新近的改动。（a recent change in the rules）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩规矩上的新近改动一样新近。（as recent as …）
到了 1984 年，货单上只剩半行字：要的是一件新近的东西。（something recent）
answers: In 1977 the trader wrote of a recent letter from the office in the list.
It was so recent that nobody in the market would go near it.
My mother thought it too recent to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a recent change in the rules.
He said nobody would call it as recent as the change in the rules they had once had.
By 1984 the list asked for nothing but something recent.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 recent 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1977 the trader wrote of a recent letter from the office in the list, and nobody forgot it.
It was the recent letter from the office that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list says.
My mother thought it too recent to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a recent change in the rules, and nobody argued with him.
The partner from the next market called the plan quite recent, and everybody laughed.
The recent ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
